seeds.name: Nat.exists_infinite_primes
seeds.label: Infinitely many primes
seeds.summary: For every natural number n, there is a prime p with n ≤ p.
seeds.formula: ∀ n ∈ ℕ, ∃ p ∈ ℕ, n ≤ p ∧ Prime(p)
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.Prime.dvd_mul
seeds.label: A prime dividing a product
seeds.summary: A prime divides a product exactly when it divides at least one factor.
seeds.formula: Prime(p) ⇒ (p ∣ m · n ↔ p ∣ m ∨ p ∣ n)
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow
seeds.label: A prime dividing a power
seeds.summary: If a prime divides a natural-number power, it divides the base.
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.gcd_comm
seeds.label: GCD is commutative
seeds.summary: Switching the two arguments leaves their greatest common divisor unchanged.
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.gcd_dvd_left
seeds.label: GCD divides the first argument
seeds.summary: The greatest common divisor of two natural numbers divides the first.
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.gcd_dvd_right
seeds.label: GCD divides the second argument
seeds.summary: The greatest common divisor of two natural numbers divides the second.
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one
seeds.label: Coprimality means GCD one
seeds.summary: Two natural numbers are coprime exactly when their greatest common divisor is one.
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.Coprime.dvd_mul_right
seeds.label: Cancel a coprime factor
seeds.summary: If k and n are coprime, k divides m · n exactly when k divides m.
seeds.formula: Coprime(k, n) ⇒ (k ∣ m · n ↔ k ∣ m)
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.ModEq.refl
seeds.label: Congruence is reflexive
seeds.summary: Every natural number is congruent to itself modulo n.
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.ModEq.trans
seeds.label: Congruence is transitive
seeds.summary: Two successive congruences with the same modulus compose.
seeds.formula: a ≡ b (mod n) ∧ b ≡ c (mod n) ⇒ a ≡ c (mod n)
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.ModEq.add
seeds.label: Add congruences
seeds.summary: Congruences with the same modulus can be added.
seeds.formula: a ≡ b (mod n) ∧ c ≡ d (mod n) ⇒ a + c ≡ b + d (mod n)
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Nat.ModEq.mul
seeds.label: Multiply congruences
seeds.summary: Congruences with the same modulus can be multiplied.
seeds.formula: a ≡ b (mod n) ∧ c ≡ d (mod n) ⇒ a · c ≡ b · d (mod n)
seeds.notation_note: Natural-number variables throughout. This notation is an editorial paraphrase.

seeds.name: Set.ext
seeds.label: Set extensionality
seeds.summary: Sets are equal when they have the same members.
seeds.formula: (∀ x, x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ B) ⇒ A = B
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Set.union_comm
seeds.label: Union is commutative
seeds.summary: Changing the order of two sets does not change their union.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Set.inter_union_distrib_left
seeds.label: Intersection distributes over union
seeds.summary: Intersecting a union equals the union of the two intersections.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: mul_inv_rev
seeds.label: Inverse of a product
seeds.summary: In a group, invert each factor and reverse their order to invert a product.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: map_inv
seeds.label: Homomorphisms preserve inverses
seeds.summary: A monoid homomorphism from a group to a division monoid preserves inversion.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: add_sq
seeds.label: Square of a sum
seeds.summary: The square of a sum expands in a commutative semiring.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
seeds.label: Rank–nullity theorem
seeds.summary: For a linear map with finite-dimensional domain over a division ring, the dimensions of its range and kernel add to the dimension of the domain.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective
seeds.label: Injective iff surjective
seeds.summary: A linear endomorphism of a finite-dimensional vector space is injective exactly when it is surjective.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: LinearMap.ker_eq_bot
seeds.label: Injectivity and the kernel
seeds.summary: A linear map has zero kernel exactly when it is injective.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: intermediate_value_Icc
seeds.label: Intermediate value theorem
seeds.summary: For a continuous function on a closed interval, every value between its endpoint values is attained. The formal theorem uses ordered topological spaces; its familiar real-valued instance is shown here.
seeds.formula: a ≤ b, f continuous on [a,b] ⇒ [f(a),f(b)] ⊆ f([a,b])
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: exists_deriv_eq_slope
seeds.label: Mean value theorem
seeds.summary: If a real function is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b), with a < b, its derivative somewhere in the interior equals the secant slope.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Real.hasDerivAt_exp
seeds.label: Derivative of the exponential
seeds.summary: The real exponential function is differentiable everywhere and is its own derivative.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Continuous.comp
seeds.label: Compose continuous maps
seeds.summary: The composition of continuous maps is continuous.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: IsCompact.image
seeds.label: Continuous image of a compact set
seeds.summary: The image of a compact set under a continuous map is compact.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: IsConnected.image
seeds.label: Continuous image of a connected set
seeds.summary: A function continuous on a connected set has connected image.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: PMF.tsum_coe
seeds.label: Total probability is one
seeds.summary: The masses of a probability mass function sum to one.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: PMF.coe_le_one
seeds.label: A probability is at most one
seeds.summary: Every individual mass in a probability mass function is at most one.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: PMF.apply_eq_one_iff
seeds.label: Certainty and singleton support
seeds.summary: An outcome has probability one exactly when it is the entire support.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Finset.card_powerset
seeds.label: Number of subsets
seeds.summary: A finite set with n elements has 2 to the power n subsets.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Finset.card_product
seeds.label: Count a Cartesian product
seeds.summary: The number of ordered pairs is the product of the sizes of the two finite sets.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.

seeds.name: Finset.card_union_add_card_inter
seeds.label: Inclusion–exclusion for two sets
seeds.summary: The sum of the sizes of the union and intersection equals the sum of the two set sizes.
seeds.notation_note: Editorial notation. The exact Lean statement below specifies all types and hypotheses.
